string.text: [COOP Family] Let us talk about matters of the heart.
Can we talk for a while, my love?
If your intentions are serious, prove yourself: win {TOURNAMENT_WINS_REQUIRED} tournaments and gain {RENOWN_REQUIRED} renown. Then return to me.
How far have I come in proving myself?
You have won {TOURNAMENT_WINS_CURRENT}/{TOURNAMENT_WINS_REQUIRED} tournaments and gained {RENOWN_CURRENT}/{RENOWN_REQUIRED} renown.
Will you marry me?
Yes. I will gladly share my life with you.
No. I am not ready for that yet.
Let us talk about our family.
How do you feel about us?
Having you beside me gives me strength.
Our army needs food. Can you obtain supplies for 1,000 denars?
Of course. I will find fair merchants and return with the supplies in two days.
Let us consider where our relationship stands.
Let us speak of something else.
I am listening. Tell me what is in your heart.
I am glad you came, my love. The baby and I are well; seeing you has done us both good.
However hard the road becomes, I feel at home when I am beside you, my love.
At last, a moment alone. I have missed you, my love.
It is good to see you. Come, stay with me a while.
You are here. Let us talk; the bond between us matters to me.
We should talk. The silence between us weighs more than any battlefield.
You are more than my spouse; you are the one to whom I have entrusted my life. Wherever we may be, you are my home.
I love you. Campaigns and politics may weary us, but the life we are building together is worth everything to me.
We are still learning one another. Do not expect perfection from me, but never doubt my loyalty.
I still care for you, or I would not be this hurt. Treat me as your life companion, not as someone under your command.
Then let me remain beside you. Not your crown, your army, or your glory, but moments like this keep my heart.
I needed to hear that. You need not carry every burden alone; there are two of us now.
Those are fine words. Show them in your deeds, and perhaps we can heal the wound between us together.

COOP Family
Enable courtship dialogue
Enables the courtship, proposal and spouse dialogue options in Coop.
Maximum spouses
Maximum number of wives for each player hero.
Minimum flirt relation
Minimum relation required before the flirt option appears.
Minimum marriage relation
Minimum relation required for a proposal.
Base compliment relation gain
Base relation gained after a successful compliment; tournament victories add 2 each, up to 15 total.
Proposal acceptance chance
Base percentage chance that an eligible lady accepts. Relation above the minimum improves it.
Require adult noble lady
Requires a living, adult, female noble who has no vanilla or custom spouse.
Courtship challenge
Tournament wins required
Tournament victories the player-lord must earn after flirting with a lady. Minimum is 2.
Renown required
New renown the player-lord must earn after flirting with a lady.
Pregnancy & Birth
Enable pregnancies
Runs the standalone server-authoritative pregnancy and birth system.
Daily pregnancy chance
Daily conception chance for each eligible married couple.
Pregnancy duration (days)
Campaign days between conception and birth.
Maximum children per mother
Zero disables conception. Existing children count toward this limit.
Maximum fertility age
Women older than this cannot conceive through this mod.
Require same location
Couples must be in the same party or settlement to conceive.
Show notifications
Shows flirting, marriage, pregnancy and birth messages.
Developer - temporary
Instant marriage test mode
Temporary test switch: instantly enables and accepts proposals from eligible unmarried adult ladies. The spouse limit remains active.
I am listening. What did you wish to tell me?
Your courage outshines every banner on the battlefield.
Your honor is rarer and more precious than any crown.
The kindness you show others is what makes you truly beautiful.
Your generous spirit brings warmth wherever you go.
Your words have touched me. I would like to know you better.
That is kind of you to say, but your words do not move me today.
Your compliment succeeded. Relation increased by {GAIN}.
